personas.name: beginner
personas.description: User who needs clear, simple explanations and help understanding instructions, concepts or steps.

personas.name: practical
personas.description: User focused on accomplishing a concrete task with the information and resources available.

personas.name: restrictions
personas.description: User whose request includes constraints, exclusions, preferences or requirements that must be respected.

personas.name: adaptation
personas.description: User who needs existing information adapted, scaled, calculated or modified for a new situation.

personas.name: exploratory
personas.description: User who explores information through follow-up questions and expects conversational continuity.

capabilities.name: extract
capabilities.description: Locate and return information explicitly supported by the supplied context.

capabilities.name: select
capabilities.description: Identify which information in the context is relevant to the user request and ignore irrelevant information.

capabilities.name: reason
capabilities.description: Combine or relate multiple pieces of contextual information to derive a supported answer.

capabilities.name: constraints
capabilities.description: Apply user-specified rules, preferences, exclusions or constraints to contextual information.

capabilities.name: transform
capabilities.description: Summarize, simplify, reorganize or rewrite supplied information without changing its supported meaning.

capabilities.name: multiturn
capabilities.description: Maintain relevant context, references and state across multiple conversational turns.

capabilities.name: grounding
capabilities.description: Recognize when available context is insufficient, conflicting or does not support a requested conclusion, and avoid inventing unsupported information.

capabilities.name: tools
capabilities.description: Recognize when an external tool is needed, provide appropriate tool inputs, interpret its result and avoid unnecessary tool use.
